name: Methylphenidate 10mg — 60 Tablets (Generic for Ritalin®)
short: Methylphenidate 10 mg, 60 tablets — central nervous system stimulant indicated for ADHD and narcolepsy. Available with prescription verification at CMC Pharmacy Cabo.
description:
Methylphenidate is a central nervous system stimulant. The active ingredient is methylphenidate hydrochloride 10 mg per tablet, and this presentation contains 60 tablets. It is commonly indicated for the treatment of attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and narcolepsy, and is recognized internationally under brand names such as Ritalin® and Concerta®.

Methylphenidate is a controlled medication in most jurisdictions, including Mexico. Treatment should always be supervised by a qualified prescribing physician; dosing should be individualized and never adjusted on your own. Consult your healthcare provider for appropriate use and monitoring.

Available at CMC Pharmacy Cabo with bilingual service and fast hotel delivery throughout the Cabo region. Prescription Required. A valid controlled-substance prescription is needed to dispense this medication. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1).
